facts.fact: Mildred 化妆台告别：她哭成泪人——「你是我最接近母亲的人」；Mildred 反手不许她弄花脸（skill：重置房间能量）
facts.anchor: The closest thing I have ever had to a mother

facts.fact: 护送揭晓：Eirene 拉线+Draven 主动——耳语「And I wanted it to be me」；Mildred 的「我不需要知道一切」调笑被 Draven 无视到底
facts.anchor: “And I wanted it to be me,”

facts.fact: Eirene 的黑装战略：全场浅色、两人全黑——「严肃、坚定、吓人——像个黑暗公主」；「had I told you, your need for order would have made you blend in」
facts.anchor: You. Are. Intimidating. Like a dark princess.

facts.fact: 蓟花冰雕：坚韧/强大/护人/「不为他人的眼光软化自己的美」——Percival 的 Glacian 之手；「谁敢碰你也会被扎」
facts.anchor: The thistle represents the best you have to offer this kingdom.

facts.fact: Mildred 的证词经 Eirene 转述：「你们绕着彼此转，像完美的 Marked Match」——Eirene 的 regal decree「给他一个机会」
facts.anchor: you two move around each other like a perfect Marked Match

facts.fact: 她在 Draven 听力范围内的自曝：「他不会越轨——他说必须由我发起」——对面的眉毛挑起来了
facts.anchor: He said it has to come from me.

facts.fact: 舞曲身世：童谣是 Eirene 唱给她的、而 Eirene 是听母亲唱的——「在我母亲死前」；Draven 惊人地不惊讶
facts.anchor: Before my mother died,” I admit.

facts.fact: 母亲之死的愧疚：她没告诉他「母亲为生她而死」——「所以我拿的是她的剑」；Draven 听着（Draven listens, too）
facts.anchor: I don’t tell him of the blame I have for her death

facts.fact: 重磅转折：他宣布放弃寻物——「better came along」；她的 Hope rushes in；他不再坚持那件「说不通」的事
facts.anchor: Let’s just say something better came along.

facts.fact: Cadmar 政体观：「力量不由弃绝证明——统治者被要求完整而非削减」；「If I were your king, I would… I would build for it. There is a difference.」
facts.anchor: Those who rule are expected to be whole, not reduced.

facts.fact: 誓词全文：放弃 Lady of Estrold+一切可通过血统/婚姻/征服持有的贵族位——全部转给 Eirene；「It. Is. Done.」；父亲在场点头
facts.anchor: I give up my titles as Lady of Estrold

facts.fact: 告别仪式：向未来女王行屈膝礼（姐妹俩都落泪）；蓟花最后一眼——「冰会融化，试炼会拿走过去的我；我不怕它意味着什么」
facts.anchor: The ice will melt in the days to follow

facts.fact: 收束：她主动牵起 Draven 的手——「我会与他结盟，换取他带来的安宁」——「I am ready to go」；他以 warrior 身份送她离宫（第一次）
facts.anchor: I will ally myself to him
